name: domain.docker_container
description: Docker container linter, multi-stage Dockerfile generator, and container security auditor

entrypoints.name: lint_dockerfile
entrypoints.description: Lint Dockerfile for root user vulnerabilities, missing cache flags, latest tag usage, and security antipatterns

entrypoints.name: generate_dockerfile
entrypoints.description: Generate an optimized, production-ready multi-stage Dockerfile for a given language/runtime

entrypoints.name: audit_container_security
entrypoints.description: Audit container runtime configuration (privileged mode, read-only rootfs, capabilities, volume mounts)
